readings: For each time-in-force value (`orders.timespan`), looking at risk/margin records matched to their order (`riskandmargin.ordervault` = `orders.recordvault`; unmatched records dropped), show the time in force, the number of distinct orders with risk/margin records (an order with several records counts once), that number's share of the total across all time-in-force values, and how much the share differs from the average share across the time-in-force values. Don't round.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
shares AS (
  SELECT timespan, order_count,
         order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM counts) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT timespan,
       order_count,
       share,
       share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS diff_from_avg_share
FROM shares;
